name: Single-Story Stone Cottage
description: Compact rubble-stone cottage under slate. Living room with hearth, table and dresser; separate bedroom. One ledged door and three shuttered casements. Single storey: no stairs. B2: chamfered plinth, bevelled quoins, keystoned openings, a stepped cornice, a dormer in the slate roof, a capped stack and ivy on the hearth gable.
